remarks:
Build Your Dream Retreat on Silver Lake!
This beautiful .25-acre lot offers the perfect opportunity to create your ideal getaway or year-round home on the shores of Silver Lake. Whether you're looking to relax by the water in the summer or enjoy all-season lake living, this property gives you plenty of space to build to your own specifications.
Located just minutes from the natural beauty of Letchworth State Park, the nostalgic charm of the Silver Lake Twin Drive-In, and the vibrant village of Perry—with its shops, restaurants, and local amenities—this is an ideal location for both relaxation and recreation.
Sale is contingent upon application approval by the Silver Lake Institute. Learn more about the community and its unique history at: https://www.silverlakeinstitute.org/
